# Printed names that operations no longer carry, from the renames of 8 and 10 November 2026.
# The lint in hack/lint/opnames fails when a Go declaration quotes one of them, so a helper,
# emitter or test cannot keep an old name by accident. Add a name here when an operation is
# renamed.
